title: RuntimeSnapshotDefinition
description: Explicit JSON Schema defining captured live container runtime configuration state.

environment.description: Target environment of the running container.

app_version.description: SemVer or build tag of the running container.

timestamp.description: ISO timestamp when snapshot was captured.

snapshot_data.description: Key-value mapping of live environment variables and runtime parameters.

status.description: Health status reported by the container runtime agent.
